  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Create, for this test, a customer, customer A, whose name is 120 letters long with no spaces, and give them an open invoice dated today, so they are in the Customer menu.
  • Create, for this test, a second customer, customer B, whose name is more than 60 characters long and includes each of these characters: & " ' < >, and give them an open invoice dated today.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Work order settings: Click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Settings, then Settings in the left menu, then the Work Orders tab. Check that Require Review Before Completion, Require Tech Story, Require Mileage and Require Engine Hours are off and Require Approval for New Lines is on, as on staging on 14 Nov 2026. Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.
  2. Make customer A: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name ZZAUTOTESTAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghij (copy it from here: 120 letters, no spaces), type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice for customer A: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type today's date in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
  4. Make customer B: Click Customers in the top bar, then New Customer. Type the Name ZZAUTOTEST Smith & Sons 'Heavy' Truck Repair <North> Alberta 5" Branch (copy it from here: more than 60 characters with & " ' < >), type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  5. Make invoice for customer B: Same way as invoice for customer A, on customer B's page: Fixed Line Total 100.00; type today's date in Invoice Date; then in the New Customer Payment window reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.

Leave them as they are; the steps below are written for these settings.

Type the Name ZZAUTOTESTAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghijAbcdefghij (copy it from here: 120 letters, no spaces), type a Phone, then click Save. On the customer's page click the edit icon beside the name; in Edit Customer pick Credit Terms "Net 30", pick Taxes "Exempt (0%)" and type 0 in Default Shop Supplies (so totals stay exact), then click Save. Click Add Contact, type a First name and Last name, then click Save. On the Assets tab click New Asset, pick the Contact, pick a Make from its list, fill any other box the window marks as required, then click Save.
  3. Make invoice for customer A: On customer A's page click New Work Order, pick the Asset, then click Save (click Ok if a Customer Notes window opens). In the New Line window type a Title, pick Labor Rate "Fixed Line Total" (type "Fixed" in the box to find it), type 100.00 in Fixed Line Total, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the line click Complete. With the work order settings as on staging (see the Work order settings item) a Missing Details window asks only for the VIN: type one and click Finish Work Order (the work order then reads Complete). If someone has switched on Require Tech Story, Require Mileage or Require Engine Hours, that window also asks for the tech story, the mileage or the engine hours: fill them in. Open the Finance tab; if Require Review Before Completion is on, click Mark Reviewed first (type the VIN there if asked, then Confirm Review). Type the date 45 days before today in Invoice Date, then click Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment window opens, reload the page (F5) so the invoice stays unpaid. Do not close that window with its ×: that takes the new invoice away again.
